About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Reporting to the Region Counsel, Region North

Position Overview:

Working with the Region Counsel, the role will provide direct country legal support for Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. The individual will also be part of the management team in Scandinavia and play a leadership role in that forum bringing legal expertise and support on business and culture related matters.

As a strategic business partner, the individual will focus on continuously building an effective legal support function addressing the most pressing legal and external environment challenges and driving/protecting the business in a proactive and creative way.

Highlighted Responsibilities:

• 
Provision of legal advice and support focused on business-oriented solutions on a wide range of matters to colleagues in Scandinavia with a specific focus on Sweden, Denmark and Iceland. Such matters include legal market access issues, medicines tendering, competition law (e.g., supply/distribution related issues), procurement law, pharmaceutical law/advertising, commercial law and general risk management (e.g., ABAC).

• 
The role will require the negotiation and preparation of an extensive range of agreements and, in some cases, negotiations with payors. The individual will need to resolve legal issues using negotiation skills and legal expertise.

• 
Monitor and proactively address with cross functional partners including GM, Government Affairs and Market Access changes in laws and the external environment that affect the business. For example, the dynamic in Denmark created by the US Most Favored Nation pricing policy (MFN). This part of the role will include driving AbbVie’s objectives at the Legal Committee of the LIF in Sweden and support creation of a legal committee in LIF Denmark.

• 
Devise legal strategy and support in cross functional meetings including MLOR meetings (Medical/Legal/OEC/Regulatory).

• 
Provide training on new developments and key legal topics of importance. Develop practical checklists and working tools for the business to facilitate their work.

• 
Represent AbbVie externally to customers, suppliers, wholesalers, competitors, government agencies.

• 
To the extent that complex problems or specific technical expertise is required, select and direct the work of outside counsel.

• 
Continuously develop a solid knowledge of AbbVie´s business and organization and knowledge of the broader business impact of decisions made.

• 
Lawyer qualified in Sweden or Denmark.

• 
Law school degree.

• 
At least 6 years of professional legal expertise, preferably in an international environment, ideally at a law firm and/or multi-national company.

• 
Experience in supporting senior business leaders.

• 
Deep understanding of Scandinavia market and culture.

• 
Highly motivated, flexible, independent with capability to manage people and take initiative. Strong integrity, and strong communication skills.

• 
Ability to prioritize and manage workload across the team and with outside counsel where needed.

• 
Solution-oriented, with ability to proactively identify solutions to complex legal and business challenges.

• 
Based in Sweden.

• 
Prepared to travel to Denmark and other RN markets as required.

• 
Fluent in English.

The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer leading energy-efficient solutions that accelerate the green transition and shape a more sustainable tomorrow. As our new Technical Product & Portfolio Manager, you will play a pivotal role at the intersection of business strategy and technology, turning emerging opportunities into high-impact, revenue-generating solutions.

By connecting strategic vision with practical execution, you will drive customer-centric innovation, transforming existing offerings and unlocking new business models across growth domains such as Data Center Cooling, Digital Services, and Connected Infrastructure Solutions.

Working within the Digital Application Solutions team, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, domain experts, R&D, and engineering teams to identify new opportunities, shape portfolio priorities, and bring concepts from exploration through implementation to deliver measurable business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive Business-Led Innovation: Identify and assess high-potential business challenges and market opportunities, building business cases and revenue models.

• Shape the Digital Portfolio: Own and refine the Digital Application Solutions portfolio, roadmaps, backlogs, dependencies, and key decisions.

• Modernize & Expand Offerings: Create new digital value propositions from existing Danfoss products and services to reach new markets.

• Act as the Core Connector: Bridge leadership, business stakeholders, R&D, domain experts, and engineering teams to align goals and direction.

• Accelerate Delivery: Drive progress from exploration and validation to implementation, delivering measurable results in weeks to months.

• Frame & Structure Concepts: Turn complex ideas into clear opportunities, hypotheses, trade-offs, and actionable next steps.

• Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with leadership on executive communication, representing the team with confidence and transparency.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong Commercial Mindset: Assess market potential, customer value, and ROI while balancing commercial and technical perspectives.

• Product & Portfolio Experience: Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner, or Portfolio Manager leading digital solutions from discovery to delivery.

• Domain & Digital Familiarity: Experience or strong interest in digital services, IoT, cloud solutions, connected products, and industrial applications.

• Exceptional Structuring Skills: Bring clarity, focus, and direction to complex and ambiguous challenges.

• Proactive Communicator: Excel at stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and team representation.

• Outcome-Driven Execution: Deliver measurable business results by driving progress, prioritizing effectively, and managing trade-offs.

• Education & Language: Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar, with fluent professional English.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Fostering a culture of continuous learning and outstanding client experience, you inspire and equip retail teams with the skills, knowledge and mindset needed to deliver on both collective and individual performance objectives. A true learning strategist, you design and deploy multi-faceted training programs and action plans that empower teams to over-achieve their POS objectives while nurturing strong performers and future people developers.

You play an essential role as the key link between the field (70% of your time) and HQ stakeholders, translating business priorities into impactful learning solutions across the following three key areas: Beauty Consultants coaching, In-class and digital trainings and Seminars.

Position

**

• Track and measure knowledge acquisition through regular quizzes, certifications and practical assessments,

• Measure the efficiency and business impact of every training through a clear set of KPIs and using sell out data

Are you motivated by working in a growing company which develops cutting edge products in the laser industry? Hamamatsu Photonics is an exciting, inspiring place to work where we encourage both personal and career development. To support our plans, we are now expanding our team as we are looking for Senior Electronics Engineers.

**About Us

**Hamamatsu Photonics is a dynamic, international high-tech company and a leader in the development, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance lasers and photonic crystal fibers. We employ some of the best and most creative people in our industry and together we have established one of the fastest growing and most innovative photonics companies in the world.

We embrace a culture in which a healthy work-life balance is encouraged; and we promote a positive, supportive working environment. To support our growth plans, we are investing in our facilities and growing our talented teams. We provide a great place to work with good people and exciting, industry-leading products.

**THE ROLE

**You will be working with a mix of custom-made technologies and ground research. You will design, develop and implement electronic systems and laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will closely collaborate with experts in your own and other fields to meet the demanding requirements. The products you develop are typically low volume but high margin, reflecting the complexity and effort put into each system. You are prepared to learn to interpret and scope fuzzy customer requirements.

• Be responsible for Electronics development for laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Work closely with experts from other areas like optics and mechanics on system design.

• Take ownership of project work packages within product development projects; work with project managers to ensure delivery of solutions within the planned deadlines and budgets.

• Interact with project and product stakeholders and communicate information clearly across the R&D organization.

• Form new and innovative design concepts and take ownership of electronics system designs.

• Create reference designs for other electronics designers in our organization.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, product improvement activities.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to industry standards

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

**

• Experience from senior roles in developing advanced PCBs for complex systems spanning the complete product life cycle.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills engaging with management and other engineering disciplines.

• Proven track record of successful PCB productization.

• Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following areas: analog design, power supplies, control loops, digital interfaces or low noise designs.

• Detailed knowledge of state of the art electronic and software technologies.

• Experience of working with external partners.

• A scientific mindset, out of the box thinker but still with a practical approach.

• Master’s degree in electronics or similar.

• English – both oral and written

**WE OFFER

**Professional challenges in a highly dynamic and growing business environment with enormous potential for further growth. An opportunity to become part of a successful, enthusiastic, development team in an informal workplace. Competitive employment terms and benefits, good work-life balance, and influence on own tasks. Experienced and skilled colleagues with highly diverse backgrounds in an international organization.

**APPLY TODAY

**We plan to invite candidates for interviews as soon as possible. If you think you have what it takes, please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in one document) to us and we will be in contact soon.

**Keep your personal data safe

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Summary

As an Entry-level Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Copenhagen, you will join a diverse project team to address complex client challenges. Responsibilities include conducting research, analysing data, preparing deliverables such as presentations and workshops, and supporting client decision-making. The role offers flexibility to specialise early, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to work across industries. Applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s is also accepted), fluency in Danish or another Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish), and English. The position values initiative, creativity, and strong analytical skills. Hybrid working and travel within the home market are part of the role. No specific industry experience or academic majors are required.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

• As a member of your project team you’ll work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients worldwide to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

• You’ll help teams understand client challenges by conducting research, gathering data, running surveys and interviews, and turning information into clear insights.

• You’ll analyze problems, identify patterns, test hypotheses, and help structure recommendations that support client decision-making.

• You’ll contribute to client-ready deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• You’ll build core consulting skills from the start, including how to structure your work, communicate clearly, contribute to team problem-solving, and manage your priorities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

• From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work.

• Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.

• As you grow, you’ll have opportunities to build confidence, take on more responsibility, and develop the skills to unlock the potential of others.

Learn and grow without limits

• Learn on the job and through formal training, developing core skills in communication, presentation, analytics, problem-solving, and client management.

• Each project will give you new opportunities to learn from specialists, broaden your perspective, and build momentum in your career.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

Who can apply?

• Applicants with a Bachelor´s (and Master’s) degree only are eligible to apply for this vacancy.

• We look for people who display initiative, intuition, and creativity with a strong problem solving and analytical mindset. We do not require specific academic majors or industry experience; we value diversity of experience and skills, extracurricular activities, and evidence of leading an interesting and impactful life outside of your studies.

• Language skills**:** Fluency in Danish or another Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish), as well as English.

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website. If you're having technical issues submitting your application or any questions, please reach out to recruiting.nordics@oliverwyman.com

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page: https://www.oliverwyman.com/careers/entry-level/interview-preparation.html

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Do you want to shape how life-changing medicines reach patients around the world? As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will lead a highly specialised team responsible for ensuring global regulatory submissions are delivered with the highest levels of quality, compliance and operational excellence.

Position to be based in Søborg, Denmark.

This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, strategic influence and regulatory expertise in a role that directly supports Novo Nordisk's mission of defeating serious chronic diseases.

**Your New Role

**As Associate Director, Publishing & Archive, you will provide leadership for a team responsible for global publishing activities and archiving. You will act as a key subject matter expert for electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) publishing, while helping to shape the future direction of the function through continuous improvement, operational excellence and strategic collaboration.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing a high-performing team, creating clarity of direction, enabling growth and ensuring effective prioritisation of activities.

• Driving business performance through clear objectives, efficient resource utilisation and successful delivery of critical publishing milestones.

• Ensuring quality, compliance and environmental management standards are maintained through a robust local Quality Management System.

• Building strong partnerships across Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Reporting, R&D, Quality Assurance, DD&IT and senior leadership, while engaging with external authorities and industry stakeholders.

• Contributing to strategic decision-making and representing Novo Nordisk in external industry forums that help influence the future of regulatory operations and submission standards.

In this role, you will have a direct impact on the successful delivery of regulatory submissions worldwide, helping ensure that innovative medicines can reach the patients who need them.

**Your New Department.

**In Research & Development, you'll be part of a unit that explores bold scientific ideas and advances them into clinical testing. We combine curiosity, AI tools and human data to develop transformative therapies. Through collaboration and operational excellence, we shape and deliver an innovative pipeline to meet future patient needs.

Within R&D, the Publishing & Archive department is part of Regulatory, Quality & Clinical Reporting Operations (RQ&C Ops). The team plays a critical role in ensuring that regulatory submissions are compliant, accurately structured and delivered across major global health authority regions, including Europe, the United States, Japan and China.

In addition, the department oversees the archiving of regulatory and Trial Master File documentation in accordance with international regulatory requirements. As Associate Director, you will lead a team whose work directly contributes to bringing new medicines to patients around the world.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong regulatory knowledge with the ability to inspire and develop people. You thrive in a complex stakeholder environment and enjoy balancing strategic priorities with operational execution.

**To Succeed In This Role, You Will Ideally Have

**

• A Master's degree and significant experience within regulatory operations, publishing, archiving or related pharmaceutical discipline, including leadership experience.

• Deep understanding of drug development processes, GxP requirements, and relevant global regulatory guidelines.

• Strong expertise in eCTD publishing and regulatory submission requirements across major health authorities such as EMA, FDA and PMDA.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

• A collaborative and resilient leadership style, with a passion for developing people, driving continuous improvement and delivering results with integrity.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity, and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to 1,245,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Contact

**For further information about the position, please contact Klaus Kjær Laigaard at KKJL@novonordisk.com

**Deadline

**

Please note that applications are screened on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo in your CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo we recognize that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.description:
**Job Description

****_Join our SAP Team in Copenhagen:

_****Be the Dual-Hatted Subject Matter Expert for Commercial & ERP Excellence.

**Are you a skilled SAP professional who thrives at the intersection of modern cloud frontends and core backend logic? We are looking for an SAP Subject Matter Expert to join our SAP team in Ørestaden.

In this role, you will be the ultimate functional authority. We need a front runner who can bridge our cutting-edge customer experience strategies and ERP backend architecture. Joining our SAP Application Management (AMS) department, you will be the core anchor driving strategic projects, and ensuring our end-to-end commercial landscape runs at full throttle.

**What The Job Is…

**In this unique position, you will split your expertise across two core pillars: acting as the primary internal owner for our CRM platform (SAP Sales & Service Cloud / C4C) and serving as an active functional expert within our SAP AMS team for SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).

• The CRM Pillar: You will maintain, configure, and develop our CRM system to optimize our customer lifecycle. For heavier technical tasks and deep development, you will have the backing of our external implementation & support partners.

• The SAP SD Pillar: You will be an active member of our SAP AMS team, managing projects within the SD area and configuring changes. Your primary mission here is to safeguard our core backend systems so that daily order intake remains completely undisturbed.

• The Digital Bridge: Simultaneously, you will be working in close alignment with our digital team to support our B2B Satair Market portal when it comes to backend synchronisation.

**Your Main Responsibilities Include

**CRM Management (SAP CX Sales & Service Cloud)

• Overseeing the day-to-day maintenance, configuration, and functional evolution of SAP Sales Cloud and Service Cloud to deliver enhancements and support.

• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting front-end business requirements and mapping them cleanly to standard SAP CRM functionalities.

• Configuring sales processes (including lead/opportunity lifecycle, pipeline management, quotations, activities).

• Configuring service processes (including Supplier discrepancies and Customer Claims handling, escalation paths, and omnichannel integration).

• Steering our external partner on advanced customizations, acting as their primary internal counterpart for heavy development deliverables.

• Staying current on the SAP roadmap and best practices to act as a trusted advisor, ensuring solutions align with our customer experience (CX) goals.

SAP SD Architecture & AMS Project Management

• Designing, customizing, and implementing functional SAP SD process solutions, including the preparation of blueprints, configuration rules, and technical documentation.

• Managing functional projects and enhancement tracks within the SD space, including taking direct project management ownership and supporting wider ARD application maps.

• Building and maintaining backend changes with a strong focus on risk mitigation to guarantee our business-critical order intake processes run smoothly.

• Partnering tightly with the internal Digital department to align configuration flows and secure flawless data exchange for the Satair Market portal.

• Executing functional unit testing and system validation for newly built configurations prior to standard release cycles, and supporting business users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

**Who You Are

**This role is defined by your mindset and professional discipline. We are looking for a teammate who is:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical/commercial field.

• Professional Foundation: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on functional experience across SAP ecosystems, featuring a clear operational split between CRM platforms and core ERP logistics.

• CRM Expertise: 3+ years of direct experience configuring SAP Sales & Service Cloud (C4C), including system lifecycles, account management, ticket handling, and standard migration toolkits (Data Workbench).

• SAP SD Expertise: Proven functional and technical proficiency executing end-to-end configurations, process design, and blueprinting inside the SAP SD module (Pricing, Billing, Order Processing, Partner Determination). S/4HANA transformation experience is a strong asset.

• Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to independently drive smaller to mid-sized IT projects or specific operational phases from blueprinting through test validation to go-live.

• Languages: Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills in English.

**Key Competencies

**

• Analytical Problem-Solving: A process-oriented mindset capable of isolating data synchronization anomalies and securing business continuity.

• Consultative Approach: Strong communication skills with the confidence to challenge business requirements, lead workshops, and align needs with best-practice SAP standard processes.

• Autonomy & Teamwork: A self-motivated individual who thrives when working independently within the AMS team while maintaining tight, proactive alignments with cross-functional digital teams.

• Adaptability: The agility to pivot effortlessly between front-end customer experience (CX) strategies and detailed backend technical configuration logic.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.occupation: Professor of Geological Mapping and Mineral Resources
jobs.description:
The Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS) seeks excellent candidates with a strong research profile in one or more disciplines related to igneous and sedimentary rock geology, geologically applied geophysics and geochemistry, ore geology, remote sensing, tectonics and structural evolution to fill a new full professor position. The professorship focuses on Greenland and the surrounding Arctic.

  You are expected to contribute to GEUS’ overall strategy by strengthening and further developing our knowledge of the geological evolution of Greenland from a combined field geology, laboratory analysis and modelling approach. An important element is advancing the understanding of the various geological settings in Greenland with a broad scientific focus spanning from paleogeography, sedimentary basins, mountain belts and rift zones to tectonic features and associated mineral systems.

  Furthermore, you are expected to promote our ideas, expertise and concepts to the surrounding societies, to deliver research output at a high international level, and to successfully obtain funding for and lead larger research projects. Moreover, the position aims to strengthen and profile our research, public sector consultancy and advisory activities.

  The position is in the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, which is located at GEUS’ main office in Copenhagen.

  About the position
 The candidate is expected to establish and further develop a strong and coherent research group in the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, which will closely cooperate with the other departments in GEUS as well as with Danish universities and relevant international research institutions. Many of GEUS’ activities in this research field are focused on the geology of Greenland and the surrounding Arctic, and fieldwork in Greenland will be a key activity. Moreover, development and application of new, innovative methods for efficient data analysis are expected to continuously contribute to the advancement of the research field, and the professor is expected to play a central role in this context.

  Candidates for professorships at GEUS must have a strong research profile in the field and have a strong publication track record in international research journals with high impact in the research field. Moreover, candidates are expected to have played and have the ambition to play a key role in advancing the research field, for example by taking part in the organisation of international conferences and by editing relevant journals and/or book series.

  Research activities are to a large extent dependent on external funding. GEUS has a strong tradition for attracting research funding from e.g. Danish research councils, the European Commission, private foundations and authorities. GEUS also leads and acts as a partner in internationally funded research projects such as EU Horizon projects. Professors at GEUS should have a strong track record of research funding and play a leading role in research funding applications and project management.

  Professors at GEUS are expected to set the direction for GEUS’ research within their field of expertise and related fields to develop and advance research and make new ideas thrive in an open and welcoming research environment. Furthermore, professors at GEUS play an active role in career planning for early-career scientific staff and take responsibility for the supervision of PhD students and postdoctoral researchers. They are also expected to have a collaborative spirit and actively engage with other professors, project managers and staff to contribute to a dynamic research environment. Moreover, professors may become members of GEUS’ research committee and act as sparring partners for management decisions on strategic planning and hiring plans for scientific staff.

  GEUS is an independent research institution under the Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities. GEUS provides research-based public sector consultancy for Danish governmental institutions and research-based advice to private companies. Professors are expected to take part in such public sector consultancy and act as sparring partners for colleagues and management in such matters.

  Who are you? 
 We seek candidates with an excellent international profile. Consideration will be given to your international network, your ability to engage and motivate staff, as well as your openness, drive and interpersonal skills.

  You have a research profile in the field, and you have visions and ideas for developing the research field. You are experienced in creating and establishing research projects with different partners, obtaining external funding, and in leading and managing large research projects.

  Experience with supervising MSc and PhD students as well as early-career researchers is a prerequisite.

  We also expect you to have experience with public sector consultancy, advisory activities (or similar), and fieldwork. Especially, experience with fieldwork in Greenland and/or another Arctic/Antarctic environment is considered advantageous.

  The Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources
 In the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, we conduct research on rocks, their mineralogy and chemical composition, and their genesis and evolution. We use this insight to provide the geological background for investment opportunities in exploration for mineral resources and data for responsible natural resource management. For this work, we have considerable in-house analytical facilities, including instruments for analysis of major and trace elements, isotopic composition and analytical microscopy.

  One of the department’s important tasks is the continuous geological mapping of Greenland. In addition to the above-mentioned tools, we acquire and analyse high-resolution stereographic images of mountain walls in our photo laboratory, which provides our geologists with a powerful tool for the development of 3D geological mapping on metres to tens of kilometres scales. Finally, the department hosts D-MIC (Danish Mineral Intelligence Centre), which analyses raw materials’ value chains, thereby linking geological knowledge to society’s need for mineral raw materials.
 
 A working environment with a focus on professional development and well-being

  There are many good reasons why you should choose a working life at GEUS.

  We are a diverse staff of about 300 committed employees. Trust and flexibility are keywords. The working environment is lively, informal and international. Our tasks are versatile and there are plenty of opportunities for you to influence the development of your task portfolio.

  We prioritise professional development, among other things by offering access to courses and other relevant activities. Socialising is also very important at GEUS, and we have a rich social life with a staff club, an art association and more.

  At GEUS, we prioritise the well-being of every single employee. We prioritise that the Heads of Departments are close to the employees, and we have flexible working hours that allow you to organise your life so that there is time for what matters to you. If you need to work from home occasionally, that is also possible.

  Furthermore, we have a gym with associated physiotherapists.

  Salary and conditions of employment
 The position as Professor is permanent. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the relevant trade union agreement. Supplements can be negotiated according to skills.

  The appointment area is the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities and its institutions.

  The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities considers diversity to be an asset and encourages anyone regardless of gender, age, religion or ethnicity to seek the position.

  Additional information
 If you would like additional information, please contact the Head of Department, Mikael Pedersen on telephone +45 22 21 65 75, e-mail mp@geus.dk, or Managing Director, Lars Nielsen, on telephone +45 91 33 38 70, e-mail larni@geus.dk.

  If you are an international applicant, you can read more about living and working in Denmark on GEUS’ website.

  Are you interested?
 Please write the application in English and include a letter of motivation, your PhD diploma and CV incl. your ORCID, as well as a complete list of publications with 1) a separate indication of peer-reviewed journal articles and 2) an indication of publications where you have been either the lead or senior author.

  Please include in the application the relevant academic works that you wish to be included in the professor assessment (max. 10). Please enclose other material that documents your research and teaching qualifications.

  You are requested to include a 2-3-page account that refers to your most important academic work with relevance to the position. Finally, you are encouraged to write a one-page explanation of your plans for the development of the field. In addition to the material that you would like to be included in the assessment, the assessment committee may choose to include further material in their assessment. It is your responsibility to send the material to the committee upon request.
 
 It is mandatory to include your updated ResearcherID and/or ORCID, which will be used to assess your publication record in Web of Science. Any recently accepted or submitted publications may be added separately to the list of publications.
 
 We must have your application at the latest on Monday 9 November 2026 (Danish time).

  Applications or other material received after the deadline will not be considered.

  The appointment procedure
 A professional assessment committee consisting of one internal and two to four external assessors at minimum professor level will carry out an individual assessment of all applicants’ professional qualifications, and the applicants will be assessed as qualified or unqualified for the position. Afterwards, an internal employment committee will decide which of the professionally qualified candidates will be invited for a job interview. This procedure is in accordance with the “Order on employment and assessment of scientific staff at the Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland § 4 and 7”.
